map.计算鼻胃管置入深度，支持测量法（NEX法）和身高公式法两种方式。: Computes nasogastric tube insertion depth by the measurement (NEX) method and a height-formula method.

map.置入深度 = 身高 × 0.2 + 鼻尖至剑突测量值: Insertion depth = height x 0.2 + nose-to-xiphoid measurement
map.测量鼻尖→耳垂→剑突的距离（NEX法），加上额外插入深度: Measure nose tip -> earlobe -> xiphoid (NEX) and add extra insertion depth
map.公式：置入深度 = 身高 × 0.2 + 鼻尖至剑突测量值: Formula: insertion depth = height x 0.2 + nose-to-xiphoid measurement
map.身高公式：身高×0.2 + 鼻尖至剑突距离: Height formula: height x 0.2 + nose-to-xiphoid distance
map.置管后可通过听诊气过水声、抽吸胃液、pH试纸检测（pH≤5.5）确认位置。: After placement confirm position by auscultating gurgle, aspirating gastric fluid, or pH paper (pH<=5.5).
map.注意：置管前需测量准确，置入过浅可能误入气管或盘绕在食管；置入过深可能造成胃黏膜: Note: measure accurately before; too shallow may enter the airway or coil in esophagus, too deep may injure mucosa. Confirm position before fixing.
map.成人鼻饲置管深度取发际或鼻尖至剑突距离，常规 45–55 cm（延长至 55–6: Adult feeding-tube depth: hairline or nose-to-xiphoid, usually 45-55 cm (extend to 55-60 cm to reduce aspiration).
map.置管后验证位置（回抽胃液/pH、听气过水声）再固定。: Verify position after placement (aspirate fluid/pH, auscultate gurgle) before fixing.
map.小儿按身长比例估算并 X 线确认，避免过浅入食管。: Children: estimate by body-length ratio and confirm by X-ray to avoid shallow esophageal placement.
map.输入标志距 NEX=52 cm，工具给置管 52–55 cm 并提示验证位置，与: Input landmark NEX=52 cm; tool gives 52-55 cm and prompts position check, matching nursing routine.
map.本工具能替代置管确认吗？: Can this tool replace tube-position confirmation?
map.不能，深度仅为估算，位置须回抽 pH 或影像确认。: No; depth is only an estimate. Position needs pH aspiration or imaging.
map.疑误入气道，立即拔除重插并评估，必要时纤支镜引导。: Suspected airway entry: remove and reinsert at once, assess, bronchoscope if needed.
map.按身高别公式估算并以 X 线定深，不套用成人绝对值。: Estimate by height formula and set depth by X-ray; do not copy adult absolutes.
